prompt: Which action lets the team avoid a new charge without losing the chance to export the comments?
promptZh: 要避免再被扣款，又保留匯出留言的機會，團隊應該採取什麼做法？

options.text: Close the old account on Friday before noon.
options.zh: 星期五中午前關閉舊帳戶。
options.whyZh: 關閉帳戶不是關閉自動續約；提前關閉帳戶可能在匯出或確認完成前失去必要的存取權限。

options.text: Wait until the export is done on Monday to cancel renewal.
options.zh: 等星期一匯出完成再取消續約。
options.whyZh: 星期一才處理會錯過星期五中午的期限。

options.text: Turn off automatic renewal by Friday at noon.
options.zh: 最晚星期五中午關閉自動續約。
options.whyZh: 能避免扣款，又能利用保留到星期一當天的唯讀存取匯出留言。

options.text: Leave automatic renewal on and make the old account read-only.
options.zh: 維持自動續約，再把舊帳戶設成唯讀。
options.whyZh: 唯讀不會關掉自動續約；維持續約仍有扣款問題。

explanationZh: 能避免扣款，又能利用保留到星期一當天的唯讀存取匯出留言。
evidence: Turn off automatic renewal by noon Friday. We'll still have read-only access through Monday, but there won't be another charge. | I can export those by Monday afternoon.

vocabulary.note: 關閉自動續約不等於關閉帳戶；本題說明關閉續約後，星期一仍可唯讀存取。
